notes.albums: Eight albums: retro (14), windbreaker and jacket (3), full zip (1), half zip (10), training and vest set (6), player version (12), kids sets (6), fan versions (15).
notes.multiPhotoGarments: Two garments carry two photographs. p220 and p221 are the same 2025/26 home fan shirt shot twice, and p183 (jacket album) and p223 (fan album) are the same navy Fly Emirates retro sweatshirt.
notes.dedupe: dedupe-0905.py found NOTHING for PSG — the client's photographs of this team are all different files from the ones we uploaded. All seven matches were made by eye against a contact sheet of the 11 live Paris Saint-Germain listings. Treat a zero-hit hash report as 'look harder', never as 'all new'.
notes.liveHandlesAreStale: Two live listings are both titled '2018/19 Fourth Retro Jersey - Neymar 10 (Jordan)' while their handles read paris-saint-germain-2023-24-away-jersey-neymar-10 and -2023-24-home-jersey-jordan. They were retitled at some point and the handles never followed, so match on the PHOTOGRAPH, not on the handle.
notes.tierSplit: Where a live listing carries no tier in its title and the batch holds the same kit in both cuts, the closest photograph was filed as listed and the other cut created with its tier in the title: the 2024/25 fourth pinstripe (fan filed, player created) and the 2024/25 fourth camo (player filed, fan created).
notes.seasonReading: Sponsor pins the era: OPEL to 2002, THOMSON 2002-2006, Fly Emirates 2006-2019, ALL Accor 2019-2022, Qatar Airways 2022 onward. Inside the Qatar Airways years the training tops, wing-print shirts and one-off colourways cannot be dated from the garment, so those titles carry a colour and are marked seasonConfidence unknown.
